scientific_question: Within the same small-mammal species, how does within-grid space use vary across sites, years and habitats after sampling effort and local population size are accounted for?

allowed_uses: comparison of candidate within-grid spatial metrics
forbidden: choose a final hypothesis solely because it is significant in RELEASE-2026
restore V6 carrier claims by reinterpreting the same response

future_confirmatory_phase.response: first future NEON small-mammal observations not contained in RELEASE-2026
future_confirmatory_phase.access_condition: final model, eligibility gates, taxonomy rule, covariates, scales and analysis code frozen before access

scale_interpretation: fixed evaluation scales derived from 10 m NEON grid geometry; not assumed home-range radii

taxonomy.ambiguous_cryptic_taxa_rule: predeclare removal or aggregation before ecological effect inspection
taxonomy.individual_consistency_check: check taxonomic consistency across repeated captures of the same resolved individual

abundance_candidates: minimum number known alive from resolved unique individuals per population-session
closed/spatial capture-recapture abundance or density where estimable

primary_spatial_response_development.unit: species x grid x sampling session
primary_spatial_response_development.family: effort- and abundance-conditioned within-grid spatial concentration
primary_spatial_response_development.candidate_statistic: multi-scale same-species neighbour support / spatial dispersion at 10, 14.14, 20 and 30 m
primary_spatial_response_development.biological_claim_boundary: population capture-space structure, not individual movement unless validated by recapture displacement

individual_movement_secondary.eligibility: sessions/years with sufficient repeated captures of resolved individuals
individual_movement_secondary.role: independent biological validation of population-level spatial concentration metric

habitat.rationale: part of NEON mammal-grid spatial sampling design and available without inventing a habitat surrogate from grid identity
habitat.secondary_covariates_policy: vegetation/topography/moisture/soil may enter only as a prospectively declared second layer after data availability is audited

development_hypotheses.statement: Within a species, spatial concentration varies among sites or years after effort and abundance are controlled.
Within a species, NLCD habitat class explains part of context dependence in within-grid spatial concentration after effort and abundance are controlled.
Population spatial spread changes with local population size rather than increasing mechanically with capture count.
development_hypotheses.sign_status: direction/function to be chosen during consumed-data development and frozen before future validation

development_hypotheses.statement: Where recaptures are estimable, population-level spatial concentration corresponds to independent individual displacement or SCR movement scale.

negative_controls: shuffle capture/use events among active trap-nights within session while preserving effort and event count
preserve individual capture frequency in spatial randomization where individual IDs are used
repeat with ambiguous cryptic taxa removed or aggregated
leave-one-individual-out influence check for sparse sessions
leave-one-night-out influence check where multiple nights are available
advance_to_future_validation_only_if: primary metric is sensitive to 10-30 m within-grid arrangement rather than grid identity
effect is not a deterministic function of abundance or number of occupied traps
effort and incomplete-grid handling are explicit
estimability gate is fixed before future response access
